text:
maria: quick question for the fantasy group — our league tiebreaker rules say highest bench points, but both teams are tied and bench pts are identical. want to flip a coin or do a rookie vote? :thinking:
devin: coinflip all the way. less drama, faster. :coin:
joel: coinflip feels lame tho, i vote rookie vote — who had the better rookie performance this week?
sara: rookie vote seems more fun. also gives us an excuse to roast nick for starting a bench scrub. :laughing:
nick: hey!!! that scrub gave me +2 pts. i will not be shamed. :sob:
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Tiebreaker method" — options: 1) Coinflip 2) Rookie vote. Vote with :one: or :two:. Poll ends in 1hr.
maria: ok poll's up. if coinflip wins, i'll do a video flip and post the clip. if rookie vote wins, post your pick and one sentence justification. no brigading pls. :zipper_mouth_face:
devin: also amen to just use head-to-head points from last 4 weeks if someone wants a third option?
joel: meh that opens up a million edge cases. keep it simple.
sara: @nick you're already campaigning? lol
nick: not campaigning, just providing historical context. :)
maria: we have 5 votes so far, leaning 2->3 to rookie. will post result when poll ends or sooner if decisive. good drama for Wednesday night slack doomscrolling. :popcorn:
